description: Metric gate expectations for the CI fixture fleet (tests/metric_gate_fleet.py). Floors/ceilings are promises; baselines pin the measured number so an unexplained move fails CI until scripts/update_metric_baselines.py records the reason. Measured on the platform's own stress-profile cells through the unmodified run_lco() harness.

soh_r2.note: Leave-cell-out SOH R^2 on the five gate-fleet cells. Floor is 4+ points below the measured value: tight enough that any real model/feature regression trips it, loose enough to absorb library-version float jitter.

rul_r2.note: Observed-EOL RUL R^2 on synthetic cells (coverage 0.68, extrapolated labels mixed in pre-v12 style). Floor 0.0: the model must at least not invert RUL ordering. Wide 50% tolerance because this metric is genuinely noisier across library versions on a 5-cell fleet.
